narrative.overview: A practical working interface organized around the next call. Warm paper surfaces, dark forest navigation, fine rules, and a restrained lime selection make the current stop easy to find while guardrails remain alongside it.
keyCharacteristics: Dense, legible work areas with clear labels and dividers.
Flat tonal panels and compact controls, with depth reserved for overlays.
Status and compliance information expressed in words as well as color.
dos: Do keep the current lead, next action, and calling constraints together.
Do pair status color with explicit text.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and labelled controls.
donts: Don't present deferred calling, import, or follow-up capabilities as already available.
